name: NGC 5264 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5264, an irregular dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc5264-hubble
story: A dwarf galaxy of irregular shape, scattered with knots of star formation that astronomers think were set off by gravitational encounters with nearby galaxies. It lies just over 15 million light-years away.

claims.text: NGC 5264 has an irregular shape with knots of star formation attributed to gravitational interactions with nearby galaxies
NGC 5264 lies just over 15 million light-years away
NGC5264 is a target of Hubble program 13442 (ACS F606W, F814W)
